package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/sha256"
"crypto/rand"
"net"
"strconv"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestBrowserReleaseLocalSmoke(t *testing.T) {
	root := os.Getenv("APTEVA_BROWSER_SMOKE")
	if root == "" {
		t.Skip("local browser fixture required")
	}
	t.Chdir(root)
	s := newBrowserSmokeServer(t)
	s.appBus = NewAppEventBus()
	s.localApps = NewLocalSupervisor(filepath.Join(root, "cache"))
	source := map[string]string{"ui-fixture": "fixture", "api": "api", "auth": "auth", "tests": "tests", "environments": "environments", "computer": "computer"}
	s.environments.ResolveEnvironmentSource = func(_ string, name, _ string) (string, error) {
		dir, ok := source[name]
		if !ok {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("unexpected dependency %s", name)
		}
		return filepath.Join(root, dir), nil
	}
	const project = "ui-browser-smoke"
	if _, err := s.store.db.Exec(`INSERT INTO projects(id,user_id,name) VALUES(?,1,'UI Browser Smoke'); INSERT INTO project_members(project_id,user_id,role,added_by) VALUES(?,1,'owner',1)`, project, project); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	install := func(dir string, bindings map[string]any) *localInstall {
		t.Helper()
		inst, err := s.installLocalSource(filepath.Join(root, dir), project, 1, nil, "", bindings, func(stage string) { t.Logf("%s: %s", dir, stage) })
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		t.Cleanup(func() { s.deleteEnvironmentInstall(inst.InstallID) })
		if _, err = s.store.db.Exec(`UPDATE app_installs SET source='git' WHERE id=?`, inst.InstallID); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return inst
	}
	auth := install("auth", nil)
	fixture := install("fixture", map[string]any{"auth": auth.InstallID})
	gateway := install("api", map[string]any{"ui-fixture": fixture.InstallID, "auth": auth.InstallID})
	environments := install("environments", nil)
	computer := install("computer", nil)
	tests := install("tests", map[string]any{"environments": environments.InstallID, "computer": computer.InstallID})
	for _, inst := range []*localInstall{auth, fixture, gateway} {
		link := filepath.Join(root, "cache", "_local", inst.AppName, "src")
		_ = os.Remove(link)
		if err := os.Symlink(filepath.Join(root, source[inst.AppName]), link); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	rpc := func(app *localInstall, name string, args map[string]any) map[string]any {
		t.Helper()
		token, err := s.appInstallToken(app.InstallID)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if app.AppName == "environments" {
			raw, err := callAppMCPTool(app.SidecarURL+"/mcp", token, name, args)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			var reply struct {
				IsError bool `json:"isError"`
				Content []struct {
					Text string `json:"text"`
				} `json:"content"`
			}
			if json.Unmarshal(raw, &reply) != nil || reply.IsError {
				t.Fatalf("%s: %s", name, raw)
			}
			var out map[string]any
			if len(reply.Content) == 0 || json.Unmarshal([]byte(reply.Content[0].Text), &out) != nil {
				t.Fatalf("%s decode: %s", name, raw)
			}
			return out
		}
		body, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"tool": name, "args": args})
		req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", app.SidecarURL+"/tools/call?project_id="+project, bytes.NewReader(body))
		req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		defer resp.Body.Close()
		raw, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
		var out map[string]any
		if resp.StatusCode >= 300 || json.Unmarshal(raw, &out) != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: %d %s", name, resp.StatusCode, raw)
		}
		return out
	}
	origin := s.localGatewayURL()
	seeds := []map[string]any{
		{"app": "auth", "tool": "auth_orgs_create", "input": map[string]any{"slug": "lab", "name": "Lab"}},
		{"app": "auth", "tool": "auth_users_create", "input": map[string]any{"organization_slug": "lab", "email": "operator@fixture.invalid", "password": "SyntheticPassword123!"}},
		{"app": "auth", "tool": "auth_clients_create", "input": map[string]any{"organization_slug": "lab", "name": "Browser fixture", "type": "spa", "allowed_origins": []string{origin}}},
		{"app": "api", "tool": "api_create", "input": map[string]any{"slug": "lab", "name": "Browser lab", "dns_mode": "skipped", "allow_http": true, "cors": map[string]any{"origins": []string{origin}}, "auth": map[string]any{"kind": "public"}}},
		{"app": "api", "tool": "api_route_add", "input": map[string]any{"api_slug": "lab", "method": "GET", "path_pattern": "/records", "target_kind": "app", "target_ref": "ui-fixture"}},
		{"app": "api", "tool": "api_route_add", "input": map[string]any{"api_slug": "lab", "method": "POST", "path_pattern": "/records", "target_kind": "app", "target_ref": "ui-fixture"}},
		{"app": "ui-fixture", "tool": "fixture_configure", "input": map[string]any{"api": map[string]any{"$target": "api"}, "auth": map[string]any{"$target": "auth"}, "client_id": map[string]any{"$ref": "2.client_id"}}},
	}
	rpc(environments, "environment_create", map[string]any{"id": "browser-release", "name": "Browser release fixture", "spec": map[string]any{
		"version": 1, "ttl_seconds": 300, "network_mode": "block", "integration_mode": "mock", "app_install_ids": []int64{fixture.InstallID, gateway.InstallID, auth.InstallID},
		"targets": map[string]any{"frontend": map[string]any{"app": "ui-fixture", "path": "/ui"}, "api": map[string]any{"app": "api", "path": "/gw/lab"}, "auth": map[string]any{"app": "auth", "path": "/login"}}, "seeds": seeds,
	}})
	version := func(dir string) string {
		raw, _ := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, dir, "apteva.yaml"))
		m, err := parseServerAppManifest(raw)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return m.Version
	}
	config := map[string]any{
		"environment_id": "browser-release", "environment_revision": 1, "gateway_app": "api", "gateway_path": "/gw/lab",
		"app_versions":    map[string]string{"api": version("api"), "auth": version("auth"), "ui-fixture": "1.0.0"},
		"candidate_probe": map[string]any{"app": "ui-fixture", "tool": "fixture_digest", "path": "/digest"},
		"read_tools":      map[string][]string{"ui-fixture": {"fixture_digest", "fixture_count"}},
		"browser": map[string]any{"value_refs": map[string]any{
			"operator.email":    map[string]any{"app": "ui-fixture", "tool": "fixture_credentials", "path": "/email"},
			"operator.password": map[string]any{"app": "ui-fixture", "tool": "fixture_credentials", "path": "/password"},
		}},
	}
	suite := rpc(tests, "tests_suite_save", map[string]any{"name": "Browser and database", "release": config})["suite"].(map[string]any)
	suiteID := suite["id"]
	definition := json.RawMessage(`{"timeout_ms":120000,"steps":[
 {"id":"open","kind":"browser","browser":{"action":"navigate","target":"frontend","path":"/"}},
 {"id":"email","kind":"browser","browser":{"action":"fill","locator":{"test_id":"email"},"value_ref":"operator.email"}},
 {"id":"password","kind":"browser","browser":{"action":"fill","locator":{"test_id":"password"},"value_ref":"operator.password"}},
 {"id":"login","kind":"browser","browser":{"action":"click","locator":{"role":"button","name":"Sign in"}}},
 {"id":"dashboard","kind":"browser","poll_every_ms":100,"browser":{"action":"observe","locator":{"role":"heading","name":"Dashboard"}},"assertions":[{"path":"/visible","op":"equals","value":true}]},
 {"id":"name","kind":"browser","browser":{"action":"fill","locator":{"test_id":"name"},"value":"Synthetic record"}},
 {"id":"save","kind":"browser","browser":{"action":"click","locator":{"role":"button","name":"Save"}}},
 {"id":"saved","kind":"browser","poll_every_ms":100,"browser":{"action":"observe","locator":{"test_id":"saved"}},"assertions":[{"path":"/text","op":"equals","value":"1"}]},
 {"id":"retry","kind":"browser","browser":{"action":"click","locator":{"role":"button","name":"Retry save"}}},
 {"id":"reload","kind":"browser","browser":{"action":"reload"}},
 {"id":"reloaded","kind":"browser","poll_every_ms":100,"browser":{"action":"observe","locator":{"test_id":"saved"}},"assertions":[{"path":"/text","op":"equals","value":"1"}]},
 {"id":"persisted","kind":"app_tool","app":"ui-fixture","tool":"fixture_count","assertions":[{"path":"/count","op":"equals","value":1}]}
 ]}`)
	check := rpc(tests, "tests_check_save", map[string]any{"suite_id": suiteID, "name": "Sign in, save, retry and reload", "kind": "scenario", "definition": definition})["check"].(map[string]any)
	raw, _ := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "fixture", "main.go"))
	digest := fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(raw))
	wait := func(id any, want string) map[string]any {
		t.Helper()
		for deadline := time.Now().Add(4 * time.Minute); time.Now().Before(deadline); time.Sleep(300 * time.Millisecond) {
			run := rpc(tests, "tests_run_get", map[string]any{"id": id})["run"].(map[string]any)
			if run["status"] == "passed" || run["status"] == "failed" {
				if run["status"] != want {
					
 t.Fatalf("want %s: %s", want, mustBrowserJSON(run))
				}
				return run
			}
		}
		t.Fatal("browser run timed out")
		return nil
	}
	start := func() any {
		return rpc(tests, "tests_run", map[string]any{"suite_id": suiteID, "candidate_digest": digest})["run"].(map[string]any)["id"]
	}
	passed := wait(start(), "passed")
 os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root,"passed.json"), []byte(mustBrowserJSON(passed)),0600)
	if strings.Contains(mustBrowserJSON(passed), "SyntheticPassword123!") {
		t.Fatal("credential leaked to evidence")
	}
	if n := countRows(t, fixture.DBPath, "SELECT count(*) FROM records"); n != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("write reached the source fixture: %d", n)
	}
	rec := passed["release"].(map[string]any)
	if _, ok := s.environments.Get(rec["runtime_id"].(string)); ok {
		t.Fatal("runtime leaked after passing")
	}
	t.Log("Real Auth sign-in, Gateway save/retry/reload and isolated persistence passed")
	badDef := strings.Replace(string(definition), `"value":"1"`, `"value":"99"`, 1)
	rpc(tests, "tests_check_save", map[string]any{"id": check["id"], "suite_id": suiteID, "name": "Intentional UI failure", "kind": "scenario", "definition": json.RawMessage(badDef)})
	failed := wait(start(), "failed")
 os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root,"failed.json"), []byte(mustBrowserJSON(failed)),0600)
	var artifacts int
	for _, row := range failed["results"].([]any) {
		steps := row.(map[string]any)["output"].(map[string]any)["steps"].([]any)
		for _, raw := range steps {
			if raw.(map[string]any)["artifact_id"] != nil {
				artifacts++
 artifactID := raw.(map[string]any)["artifact_id"]
 token, _ := s.appInstallToken(tests.InstallID)
 req, _ := http.NewRequest("GET", fmt.Sprintf("%s/artifacts/%v?project_id=%s",tests.SidecarURL,artifactID,project),nil)
 req.Header.Set("Authorization","Bearer "+token)
 resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
 if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 image, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body); resp.Body.Close()
 if resp.StatusCode != 200 || len(image) < 8 {t.Fatalf("artifact unavailable: %d",resp.StatusCode)}
 os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root,"failure.png"),image,0600)

			}
		}
	}
	if artifacts != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("missing failure screenshot: %s", mustBrowserJSON(failed))
	}
	failedRelease := failed["release"].(map[string]any)
	verdict := rpc(tests, "tests_release_verdict", map[string]any{"suite_id": suiteID, "candidate_digest": digest, "suite_revision": failedRelease["suite_revision"], "fixture_revision": failedRelease["fixture_revision"]})
	if verdict["allowed"] != false {
		t.Fatal("failing browser passed the release gate")
	}
	cancelDef := json.RawMessage(`{"steps":[{"id":"open","kind":"browser","browser":{"action":"navigate","target":"frontend","path":"/"}},{"id":"wait","kind":"browser","poll_every_ms":100,"timeout_ms":30000,"browser":{"action":"observe","locator":{"test_id":"never"}},"assertions":[{"path":"/visible","op":"equals","value":true}]}]}`)
	rpc(tests, "tests_check_save", map[string]any{"id": check["id"], "suite_id": suiteID, "name": "Cancellation", "kind": "scenario", "definition": cancelDef})
	id := start()
	time.Sleep(5 * time.Second)
	rpc(tests, "tests_run_cancel", map[string]any{"id": id})
	cancelled := wait(id, "failed")
	if cancelled["cancel_requested"] != true {
		t.Fatal("cancel was lost")
	}
	db, err := sql.Open("sqlite", computer.DBPath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer db.Close()
	var active int
	if err = db.QueryRow("SELECT count(*) FROM computer_test_sessions WHERE state IN ('starting','active')").Scan(&active); err != nil || active != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("active browser leak %d %v", active, err)
	}
	t.Log("Intentional failure blocked the verdict, retained a screenshot and cancellation removed the browser")
}
func mustBrowserJSON(v any) string { raw, _ := json.Marshal(v); return string(raw) }

func newBrowserSmokeServer(t *testing.T) *Server {
	t.Helper()
	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("listen: %v", err)
	}
	port := listener.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr).Port
	dataDir := t.TempDir()
	store, err := NewStore(filepath.Join(dataDir, "server.db"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("store: %v", err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { store.Close() })
	secret := make([]byte, 32)
	_, _ = rand.Read(secret)

	s := &Server{
		store:   store,
		secret:  secret,
		port:    strconv.Itoa(port),
		dataDir: dataDir,
		agents:  NewAgentManager(filepath.Join(dataDir, "agents"), ""),
		// Stable cache OUTSIDE t.TempDir: Go's module cache is written
		// read-only, which breaks TempDir's RemoveAll cleanup; keeping it
		// here also reuses the build cache across runs. Per-install data
		// dirs under it are removed by Environment.Stop.
		localApps:      NewLocalSupervisor(filepath.Join(os.TempDir(), "apteva-environment-test-appcache")),
		installedApps:  NewInstalledAppsRegistry(),
		broadcaster:    NewTelemetryBroadcaster(),
		instanceSecret: "environment-e2e-secret",
		environments:   NewEnvironmentManager(environmentDataRoot(dataDir)),
	}
	s.environments.server = s

	// A catalog with a synthetic twitter-api app so the integration callback
	// can resolve the app + tool. The per-environment interceptor short-circuits
	// before any real request is built, so a minimal tool def suffices.
	cat := NewAppCatalog()
	cat.apps["twitter-api"] = &AppTemplate{
		Slug:  "twitter-api",
		Name:  "Twitter",
		Tools: []AppToolDef{{Name: "post_tweet", Method: "POST", Path: "/2/tweets"}},
	}
	s.catalog = cat

	// A user so the dev-token callback (installed_by → user) resolves to a
	// real owner the seeded connection belongs to.
	if _, err := store.CreateUser("environment-e2e@example.com", "x"); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create user: %v", err)
	}

	// Mount the app-callback route so in-environment sidecars' platform calls
	// (ExecuteIntegrationTool → /api/apps/callback/integrations/:id/execute)
	// reach the real handler → the per-environment interceptor.
	apiMux := http.NewServeMux()
	s.registerAppRuntimeRoutes(apiMux)
 apiMux.HandleFunc("/environment-app-public/", s.handleEnvironmentAppPublicGateway)
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.Handle("/api/", http.StripPrefix("/api", apiMux))
	httpServer := &http.Server{Handler: mux, ReadHeaderTimeout: 5 * time.Second}
	go httpServer.Serve(listener) //nolint:errcheck
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = httpServer.Close() })
	return s
}
